{{Infobox |eng = Soggy Newspaper |source = [[Tools#Fishing Poles|Fishing Pole]] • [[Crab Pot]] • [[Garbage Can]]s • [[Fish Pond]] • [[Animals#Cat or Dog|Cat]] |xp = * Fishing Pole: 3 [[Fishing#Experience Points|Fishing XP]] * Crab Pot: 5 [[Fishing#Experience Points|Fishing XP]] * Fish Pond: 10 [[Fishing#Experience Points|Fishing XP]] |sellprice = 0 |quality = false |season = All }} '''Soggy Newspaper''' is a type of [[trash]] that can be caught when fishing during all seasons, in any location, using either a [[Tools#Fishing Poles|Fishing Pole]] or a [[Crab Pot]]. It can also be found in [[Garbage Can]]s, and any crab pot fish may produce Soggy Newspaper when placed in a [[Fish Pond]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. Soggy Newspaper can be [[Recycling Machine|recycled]] into [[Torch]]es or [[Cloth]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |hate=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus }} ==Recycling== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Item !Equipment !Product !Recycling Time |- |{{Name|Soggy Newspaper}} |{{Name|Recycling Machine}} |3 {{Name|Torch|90%|class=inline|link=Torch{{!}}Torches}} or
1 {{Name|Cloth|10%|class=inline}} |{{duration|1h}} |} ==Bundles== Soggy Newspaper can be recycled into [[Cloth]], which is used in the {{Bundle|Artisan||y}}. ==Recipes== Soggy Newspaper is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Soggy Newspaper can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Trash Can Shirt]].
